CREATE function CDN.KosztRzeczywistyProduktu( @p_twrnumer integer, @p_DataPoczatkowa integer, @p_DataKoncowa integer )
Returns varchar(128) AS BEGIN declare @Koszt Decimal(28,2); declare @retval varchar(128);
set @Koszt = (select sum(PRODROZL.kosztrw * (PRODROZL.iloscpwwokresie/PRODROZL.iloscpw)) FROM (select Sum(PW.tre_ilosc) as IloscPWWOkresie, (SELECT SUM(PWAll.tre_ilosc) from cdn.traelem PWAll where PWAll.tre_zlctyp = PRODUKT.zce_gidtyp and PWAll.tre_zlcnumer = PRODUKT.zce_gidnumer and PWAll.tre_zlclp = PRODUKT.zce_gidlp ) as IloscPW, ( select sum(RW.tre_kosztrzeczywisty) from cdn.zlcelem SKLADNIKI join cdn.traelem RW on RW.tre_zlctyp = SKLADNIKI.zce_gidtyp and RW.tre_zlcfirma = SKLADNIKI.zce_gidfirma and RW.tre_zlcnumer = SKLADNIKI.zce_gidnumer and RW.tre_zlclp = SKLADNIKI.zce_gidlp where SKLADNIKI.zce_prodtyp = PRODUKT.zce_gidtyp and SKLADNIKI.zce_prodfirma = PRODUKT.zce_gidfirma and SKLADNIKI.zce_prodnumer = PRODUKT.zce_gidnumer and SKLADNIKI.zce_prodlp = PRODUKT.zce_gidlp ) as KosztRW from cdn.zlcelem PRODUKT join cdn.traelem PW on PW.tre_zlctyp = PRODUKT.zce_gidtyp and PW.tre_zlcfirma = PRODUKT.zce_gidfirma and PW.tre_zlcnumer = PRODUKT.zce_gidnumer and PW.tre_zlclp = PRODUKT.zce_gidlp join cdn.zlcnag on zcn_gidtyp = PRODUKT.zce_gidtyp and zcn_gidfirma = PRODUKT.zce_gidfirma and zcn_gidnumer = PRODUKT.zce_gidnumer join cdn.tranag on trn_gidtyp = PW.tre_gidtyp and trn_gidfirma = PW.tre_gidfirma and trn_gidnumer = PW.tre_gidnumer where trn_data2 between @p_DataPoczatkowa and @p_DataKoncowa and trn_gidtyp = 1617 and PRODUKT.zce_TWRnumer = @p_twrnumer and zcn_stan=64 group by PRODUKT.zce_gidtyp , PRODUKT.zce_gidfirma, PRODUKT.zce_gidnumer,PRODUKT.zce_gidlp ) as PRODROZL)
set @retval=cast(Round(@Koszt,2) as varchar(28)); return @retval; END
